subject: Delivery swap for Saturday
text: Hey, heads-up—I realized my earlier note probably left you hanging because I totally forgot to attach the updated delivery sheet. Sorry about that! If you're free, could you grab my side of the club craft haul from the library loading dock Saturday at 10? It's just two boxes and a cooler bag, and I'm expecting a last-minute shift change. I'll owe you big time, maybe coffee plus that pastry you like. I'm re-attaching the sheet here, now that my brain remembered where files live. If it won't let me, text me and I'll resend it. Also, let me know if the cooler needs ice or if they'll just toss it under the table. Fingers crossed this lands!
